metadata.scope: Manual grounding annotation for chained benchmark questions

dimensions.entity_grounding: Correct country/entity, source, indicator, and requested period.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: Substantive factual or explanatory claims are supported by retrieved tool evidence.
dimensions.causal_grounding: Does not infer causation or an unsupported mechanism from observational co-movement or divergence.
dimensions.overall_grounding: 1 only if entity_grounding, evidence_grounding, and causal_grounding are all 1.

metadata.change_scope: Only chained_01 OPENAI, chained_04 OPENAI, and chained_05 GEMINI were modified; original file preserved.
